name: Multi-factor heuristic gateway scoring
operational_definition: Score eligible endpoints with operator-defined weights and runtime telemetry then choose the highest score or explore stochastically
candidate_set: Configured model provider account and deployment targets
signals: health; circuit state; quota; price; latency; task patterns; context; cache; stability; tier
decision_mechanism: Weighted score rules and optional exploration
optimization_objective: cost; latency; reliability; quota utilization; approximate task fit
learning_mode: No learned update required; optional manually tuned or bandit-like exploration
execution_pattern: single selection with sticky session and fallback
constraints: Weight calibration signal comparability and catalog drift
fallback: Circuit breaker ordered alternatives or last-known-good
feedback_loop: Telemetry updates and operator tuning; learning may be absent
claimed_advantages: Transparent controllable and compatible with many providers
known_failure_modes: Heuristic task-fit errors gaming conflicting scales unstable exploration and no quality guarantee
notes: Do not describe epsilon-random exploration as a learned bandit without reward updates

name: Capability requirement prediction with profile matching
operational_definition: Predict a vector of task requirements and select the cheapest configured model profile satisfying them
candidate_set: Heterogeneous model pool described by editable capability profiles
signals: reasoning depth; code generation; debugging; tool orchestration; language-invariant task representation; live health
decision_mechanism: Multi-head classifier followed by shortfall matching
optimization_objective: quality floor subject to cost and availability
learning_mode: Offline supervised training; model catalog decoupled from predictor weights
execution_pattern: single model selection with health-aware availability handling
constraints: Accuracy of requirement labels and model profiles; domain transfer beyond coding
fallback: Next eligible capable model and availability-aware selection
feedback_loop: Offline retraining of predictor and configuration updates for model profiles
claimed_advantages: Adds or removes models without retraining router; multi-dimensional fit
known_failure_modes: Profile staleness correlated capability errors and domain-specific training bias
notes: HyDRA is the primary current case

name: Pairwise weak-strong quality prediction
operational_definition: Estimate whether a cheaper model will meet the required quality for a prompt and escalate to a stronger model when a threshold is crossed
candidate_set: Exactly two models or a designated weak-strong pair
signals: prompt representation; preference data; predicted response quality; configured threshold
decision_mechanism: Classifier ranker matrix factorization or quality predictor
optimization_objective: minimize cost while retaining a strong-model quality target
learning_mode: Offline training; no online application feedback in the AWS case
constraints: Model-pair dependence threshold calibration language and workload drift
feedback_loop: Periodic retraining recalibration or manual threshold review
known_failure_modes: Binary framing ignores broader model diversity and may miss quality floors after drift
notes: AWS and RouteLLM differ in training disclosure and product constraints

name: Multi-model task-aware ranking
operational_definition: Represent a prompt or task then rank several models by predicted quality with cost latency or policy tradeoffs
signals: prompt complexity; task type; model capability; historical preferences or usage; cost; latency; policy eligibility
decision_mechanism: Trained classifier ranker or proprietary meta-model
optimization_objective: quality cost and latency under policy constraints
learning_mode: Offline pre-training and optionally customer-specific training; online signals vary
constraints: Opaque training data changing pools uncertain calibration and limited independent validation
fallback: Next eligible model or provider fallback
feedback_loop: Vendor retraining customer evaluation data or aggregate usage updates
claimed_advantages: Broader specialization than a binary router
known_failure_modes: Expensive-model bias popularity feedback loops drift and benchmark overfitting
notes: Keep provider routing separate from model-ranking outcomes

name: Provider telemetry routing and failover
operational_definition: Choose where to execute a selected model using health capacity price latency throughput quota region and policy signals
candidate_set: Multiple endpoints providers accounts or regions serving the same or substitutable model
signals: outages; error rate; throughput; time to first token; price; quota; region; data policy; cache affinity
decision_mechanism: Eligibility filter weighted ordering load balancing circuit breaker and fallback
optimization_objective: availability latency cost sovereignty and capacity
learning_mode: Live telemetry with heuristic updates; learned quality selection usually absent
execution_pattern: single endpoint with retries fallback and session stickiness
constraints: Telemetry lag correlated provider failure cache loss data policy and retry amplification
feedback_loop: Continuous health metrics and operator policy updates
claimed_advantages: Reliability and infrastructure arbitrage without application code changes
known_failure_modes: Failure storms hidden routing choices duplicate billing and policy leakage
notes: A successful provider route does not prove correct model choice

name: Deterministic policy graph routing
operational_definition: Execute a versioned directed flow of conditions traffic splits budgets rate limits model calls and fallbacks
candidate_set: Operator-selected models providers and control nodes
signals: metadata; headers; request fields; user plan; geography; budget; rate; percentage allocation
decision_mechanism: If-else graph percentage split and quota gates
optimization_objective: governance experimentation spend control reliability and rollout safety
learning_mode: None unless external evaluators update the graph
execution_pattern: conditional path with optional chained calls and fallback
constraints: Policy complexity manual maintenance and missing quality prediction
fallback: Explicit graph edges and rollback to prior version
feedback_loop: Analytics human review and configuration revisions
claimed_advantages: Auditability instant rollback and non-technical control
known_failure_modes: Rule explosion stale segments and false confidence from deterministic control
notes: Cloudflare Microsoft and Vercel are current but materially different control-plane cases

name: Global budget and capacity constrained allocation
operational_definition: Predict cost and utility then allocate a workload across models to satisfy aggregate budget performance latency and capacity constraints
candidate_set: Multiple models with heterogeneous costs capabilities and concurrency
signals: predicted capability; predicted cost; budget; quality threshold; latency; capacity
decision_mechanism: Retrieval-augmented predictor plus constrained optimization and Lagrangian updates
optimization_objective: global utility under cost quality and capacity constraints
learning_mode: Offline predictor training with iterative optimizer
execution_pattern: workload-level assignments rather than independent greedy calls
constraints: Prediction error changing prices runtime arrivals and target compliance
feedback_loop: Recompute allocation as workload and constraints change
claimed_advantages: Avoids wasting budget on locally attractive low-value upgrades
known_failure_modes: Can miss runtime quality floors and may be hard to operate online
notes: Pair OmniRouter result with PROTEUS counterevidence

name: Runtime SLA-aware or online adaptive routing
operational_definition: Accept an explicit quality or budget target at runtime and update a policy from outcomes or terminal rewards
signals: task context; target quality; cost; latency; capacity; observed reward; terminal success
decision_mechanism: Target-conditioned learned policy contextual bandit or reinforcement learning
optimization_objective: SLA compliance constrained cost and routing regret
learning_mode: Offline and online learning with exploration
execution_pattern: single task-pinned route or adaptive workload allocation
constraints: Delayed sparse rewards safety of exploration nonstationarity and operator trust
fallback: Safe baseline abstention or stronger-model escalation
feedback_loop: Reward-conditioned policy update and drift detection
claimed_advantages: Adapts to changing workloads and explicit service tiers
known_failure_modes: Unsafe exploration reward hacking slow feedback and unstable compliance
notes: BaRP and MESS+ strengthen this family but neither is independent live-production validation

name: Parallel ensemble and judge fusion
operational_definition: Send one request to multiple models and synthesize or select their outputs with another model or rule
candidate_set: Panel of diverse models plus judge or synthesizer
signals: prompt; model outputs; optional web or tool evidence; judge scores
learning_mode: Usually none per request; panel and judge may be manually configured
constraints: Multiplied cost latency data exposure correlated errors and judge bias
fallback: Fallback to direct model or partial panel
known_failure_modes: Judge failure consensus hallucination privacy expansion and poor unit economics

name: Temporal trajectory-aware escalation
operational_definition: Start with a cheaper model for bounded exploratory steps then use the observed partial trajectory to decide whether to continue or escalate
candidate_set: A weak-strong model pair within one agent harness
signals: task prompt; intermediate actions; tool observations; partial progress; estimated continuation value; accumulated cost
decision_mechanism: Temporal value model and escalation threshold
optimization_objective: task success under total trajectory cost and latency
learning_mode: Offline training on recorded trajectories with threshold calibration
execution_pattern: sequential explore then continue or escalate
constraints: Exploration can waste time or contaminate state and late escalation may duplicate work
fallback: Escalate to the stronger model or stop at the frozen budget
feedback_loop: Trajectory outcome labels and periodic recalibration
claimed_advantages: Reveals difficulty that is not identifiable from the initial prompt
known_failure_modes: Harness dependence delayed switching state-transfer failure and exploration overhead
notes: SWE-Router is the first accepted comparator for this family

name: Multimodal signal-aware media routing
operational_definition: Rank models using text image audio or video signals plus capability eligibility and operational preferences
candidate_set: Heterogeneous multimodal or generative-media model pool
signals: modality; text and media embeddings; capability fit; quality; price; latency; energy; allow and deny policy
decision_mechanism: Multimodal feature fusion eligibility filtering and learned or configured scoring
optimization_objective: quality cost latency energy and capability compliance
learning_mode: Offline learned policy or operator-configured preference scoring
execution_pattern: single model selection across cloud or edge and media families
constraints: Media benchmarks and normalized costs may not transfer to live generation quality or provider drift
fallback: Next eligible modality-capable model or operator-approved default
feedback_loop: Benchmark refresh preference updates and model-catalog updates
claimed_advantages: Extends routing beyond text and exposes modality-specific information
known_failure_modes: Cross-modal calibration subjective media quality and expensive evaluation
notes: MMR-Bench supplies evaluation evidence while Runway supplies a live product surface

name: Decision-aware comparative anti-collapse routing
operational_definition: Learn relative candidate ordering directly instead of independent scalar quality scores and inspect model call shares across budget sweeps
candidate_set: Multiple models with overlapping capability and cost
signals: query representation; model representations; pairwise compatibility; budget; model call share
optimization_objective: quality-cost frontier without degenerating to the strongest model
learning_mode: Offline supervised learning with OOD checks
constraints: Near ties label imbalance and decision errors can still produce collapse
fallback: Calibrated fixed model or constrained call-share policy
feedback_loop: Retraining with balanced labels and anti-collapse diagnostics
claimed_advantages: Aligns the training target with the discrete routing decision
known_failure_modes: Offline benchmark dependence and possible underuse of legitimately superior models
notes: Do not adopt call-share balancing as an objective without preserving quality floors

name: Joint model and generation-budget routing
operational_definition: Select both the candidate model and an output-length budget so cost-quality options include constrained responses from stronger models
candidate_set: Models evaluated at multiple response-length budgets
signals: prompt; predicted quality by model and length; token budget; price; instruction compliance
decision_mechanism: Joint model-budget search or learned reasoning over candidate configurations
optimization_objective: quality under explicit token or monetary budget
learning_mode: Offline training on model-by-length outcome data
execution_pattern: single model call with a length constraint
constraints: Models may not obey length instructions and shorter outputs can hide omissions
fallback: Unconstrained approved model or fixed response budget
feedback_loop: Refresh behavior across model versions and prompt styles
claimed_advantages: Finds configurations missed by one fixed cost-quality estimate per model
known_failure_modes: Length-control noncompliance benchmark specificity and answer-style bias
notes: R2-Router supplies the initial evidence; independent reproduction is required

name: Multi-round router-agent selection and aggregation
operational_definition: Use a routing model as a sequential policy that may invoke several candidate models reason over returned information and aggregate a final answer
candidate_set: Specialist model pool described by capability and cost
signals: task state; prior model outputs; model descriptors; remaining budget; reward
decision_mechanism: Reinforcement-learned think route and aggregate policy
optimization_objective: answer quality under cumulative call cost
learning_mode: Offline reinforcement learning with rule-based outcome and cost rewards
constraints: Compounded latency multiplied exposure reward hacking and correlated model errors
fallback: Terminate with current evidence or fall back to one trusted model
feedback_loop: Trajectory rewards offline evaluation and pool refresh
claimed_advantages: Can combine complementary model capabilities and adapt call depth
known_failure_modes: QA benchmark bias descriptor staleness and difficult causal attribution
notes: Evaluate separately from fixed parallel ensembles

name: Safety-first eligibility and route-integrity controls
operational_definition: Apply policy safety privacy and adversarial-integrity checks before the quality-cost selector and verify that untrusted input cannot force a prohibited route
candidate_set: Models and routes annotated with safety privacy data-handling and cost policy
signals: content class; policy eligibility; privacy requirement; anomaly score; requested tools; fallback reason
decision_mechanism: Hard eligibility filter plus route-manipulation detector and audit trail
optimization_objective: safety privacy policy compliance and bounded adversarial cost
learning_mode: Rules and detectors updated from incidents and adversarial tests
execution_pattern: eligible route selection followed by monitored fallback
constraints: False positives adaptive attacks policy drift and unsafe fallback destinations
fallback: Fail closed abstain or route to a reviewed safe default
feedback_loop: Adversarial evaluation incident review and signed policy updates
claimed_advantages: Prevents cost optimization from silently weakening safety or privacy
known_failure_modes: Attack transfer detector evasion and conflicts with availability
notes: Security papers establish the evaluation need not universal defense efficacy

name: Agent handoff and supervisor dispatch
operational_definition: Expose specialist agents as callable destinations and let a triage model or supervisor select delegate and optionally synthesize their work
candidate_set: Named specialist agents with tool permissions and scopes
signals: conversation state; specialist descriptions; metadata; task decomposition; collaborator status
decision_mechanism: LLM tool selection handoff or supervisor plan
optimization_objective: task completion specialization and coordination quality
learning_mode: Prompt and configuration driven unless an external learning loop is added
constraints: Delegation loops context leakage authority confusion and missing comparative evaluation
fallback: Return to supervisor default agent or human escalation
feedback_loop: Trace review agent updates and policy controls
claimed_advantages: Separates capability ownership and can route beyond model identity
known_failure_modes: No inherent quality guarantee and broader action authority than model routing
notes: OpenAI and AWS document mechanisms but not a common outcome benchmark

name: Conformal violation-rate calibrated routing
operational_definition: Train a query-only gate for whether a cheap model is safe then select its routing threshold on held-out calibration data using an exact upper confidence bound on violations among cheap-routed queries
candidate_set: Exactly two models in the demonstrated method; a designated cheap-expensive pair
signals: prompt embedding; binary cheap-versus-expensive correctness label; held-out calibration scores; alpha violation tolerance; delta confidence parameter
decision_mechanism: Classifier score followed by Clopper-Pearson threshold calibration; route nothing to the cheap model if no threshold satisfies the bound
optimization_objective: maximize cheap-model coverage and cost savings subject to a high-probability bound on routed-subset violation rate
learning_mode: Offline supervised gate training plus held-out finite-sample calibration
execution_pattern: single query selection with expensive-model fallback
constraints: Exchangeability between calibration and deployment; adequate calibration sample; monotonic risk behavior; fixed label rule model pair alpha and delta; aggregate rather than subgroup control
fallback: Route to the expensive model; if no valid threshold exists set the threshold to infinity and route no queries cheaply
feedback_loop: Recalibrate and revalidate after model workload label or query-distribution change
claimed_advantages: Adds an explicit finite-sample risk constraint to a weak-strong cost-quality router
known_failure_modes: Low coverage with a weak gate; distribution shift; subgroup violations; coarse binary labels; single-pair and single-split overfitting
notes: Distinct from MTH-003: it can use the same pairwise predictor but adds a statistically calibrated routed-subset risk constraint and abstaining threshold rule

name: Carbon-aware constrained model routing
operational_definition: Estimate each candidate model's correctness p95 latency and request carbon then select the lowest-carbon feasible route; optionally update a dual carbon price against a rolling budget
candidate_set: Multiple fixed candidate models with heterogeneous quality latency and energy profiles
signals: query features; predicted correctness; p95 latency; estimated token count; model energy per 1000 tokens; time and region grid intensity; accuracy latency and rolling-carbon targets
decision_mechanism: Feasibility filter followed by carbon minimization or a primal-dual penalized objective with sliding-window dual updates
optimization_objective: minimize modeled grams CO2 while satisfying accuracy latency and optional rolling carbon-budget constraints
learning_mode: Offline predictor fitting with online dual-variable updates
execution_pattern: single-model route per request with rolling budget control
constraints: Prediction calibration; energy-estimator validity; timely regional grid intensity; fixed candidate pool; paper-defined quality and latency thresholds
fallback: If the feasible set is empty consider all models and choose the minimum constraint violation; GAR-Fixed can remove its hard carbon cap
feedback_loop: Update the rolling carbon shadow price and periodically recalibrate correctness latency energy and grid inputs
claimed_advantages: Makes carbon an explicit time-and-region-sensitive routing objective while retaining quality and latency constraints
known_failure_modes: Stale grid data; predictor and token-estimation error; geographic accounting assumptions; missing monetary cost; fixed pool; no full regret proof; modeled rather than directly measured production emissions
notes: Distinct from MTH-007 aggregate budget allocation and MTH-008 online SLA adaptation, but composable with both; do not collapse energy megajoules modeled CO2 and money
